name: Debashish Deb
title: Research IT at Färkkilä Lab
tagline: I maintain research data infrastructure, support scientific computing on CSC systems, and document image processing workflows so the lab can run them again.
about: I trained in molecular biotechnology and worked as a research assistant before moving into IT. That background shapes how I document a workflow: what goes in, what comes out, and how someone else can run it again.
aboutExtended:
I trained in molecular biotechnology and worked as a research assistant before moving into IT. That background shapes how I document a workflow: what goes in, what comes out, and how someone else can run it again.

I maintain research data infrastructure, support scientific computing on CSC systems, and document image processing workflows so the lab can run them again.

collaborationServices.title: Research IT and data infrastructure
collaborationServices.description: I maintain research databases and data infrastructure across local and cloud environments, and help lab members troubleshoot access and day-to-day technical issues.
deliverables: Research data across local and cloud environments

collaborationServices.title: Scientific computing and image processing
collaborationServices.description: I maintain workflows on CSC systems and document the steps used to prepare microscopy images for analysis. The goal is to make runs easier to repeat and troubleshoot.

collaborationServices.title: Research web development
collaborationServices.description: I designed and built the lab’s public website and continue to maintain it. It gives researchers and visitors a place to find the lab’s work, publications, people and news.

projects.name: Riverlines — The River Remembers
projects.description: A bilingual documentary player for archival footage of Dhaka’s Buriganga River. Switch the transcript between Bangla and English, or select a transcript line to jump to that moment in the film.
highlights: Selectable cues jump to the corresponding moment in the film

projects.name: Bioimage workflows on CSC and LUMI
projects.description: I maintain workflows on CSC systems and document the steps used to prepare microscopy images for analysis. The goal is to make runs easier to repeat and troubleshoot.
highlights: Document image preparation steps so researchers can repeat runs
Support workflow troubleshooting on CSC systems

projects.name: Jutera — Web QA
projects.description: I investigated why switching languages could interrupt an in-progress inquiry. After separating submission state from translated page metadata, I verified that the request stayed active and that a failed attempt preserved the draft.
highlights: Verified with controlled browser requests; mailbox delivery was outside the test.

projects.name: BDNewsReader
projects.description: Bilingual news reader platform built with Flutter, Riverpod, and a self-hosted Fastify backend. Features native article formatting, offline caching via Drift/SQLite, YouTube live stream playback, and bilingual text-to-speech narration.
highlights: Self-hosted Fastify backend aggregating and caching verified news streams
Bilingual text-to-speech audio narration and offline SQLite storage

projects.name: Färkkilä Lab website and research IT
projects.description: I designed and built the lab’s public website and continue to maintain it. It gives researchers and visitors a place to find the lab’s work, publications, people and news.
highlights: Designed and built the lab’s website
Maintain its public research, people, publications and news pages

projects.name: Stations-Pathfinder
projects.description: Graph routing engine written in Golang that calculates optimal collision-free paths for concurrent trains moving across dynamic railway track topologies with turn-based orchestration.
highlights: Concurrent turn-based simulation with dynamic collision avoidance
Graph traversal algorithm finding Pareto-optimal transit solutions

projects.name: Art-Interface
projects.description: Interactive web application and parsing engine in Golang that transforms, parses, and renders banner-style ASCII art typography through a clean browser interface.
highlights: Custom ASCII font parser and rasterizer written using Go standard library
Real-time client-side preview with clean responsive output
